tf86bd21e4: NIST's media sanitization guide, SP 800-88, got a new revision in September 2025. It defines three methods: clear (logical techniques, such as overwriting the data, that protect against simple recovery), purge (techniques that withstand even laboratory recovery and keep the disk reusable, such as cryptographic erase) and destroy (the device is physically destroyed). The choice depends on what was on the disk and where it's going. And take note: the guide warns that techniques designed for magnetic disks may not reach all the data on an SSD.
